column1: # OS VERSION PATH UID GROUP MODE (octal); no discovery or package ownership query.
# PATH is stat'ed through links; one absent on an image is skipped, a present
# one with another owner, group or mode refuses setup. GROUP is a gid, or the
# name of a group whose id the image's packages allocate.
# Ubuntu entries stat-checked in a fresh ubuntu:26.04 (26.04.1) container with
# sudo, uidmap, openssh, dbus, polkit, fuse3, cron, at and podman installed.
# /usr/bin/sudo is an alternatives link to sudo-rs there.
# RHEL entries stat-checked on a RHEL 10.2 devspace, not a stock host.
